editorial_review_row.author: NAFT Editorial
editorial_review_row.content: Admirals is a legitimate Tier-1 regulated broker scoring 7.0/10 from NAFT in 2026. FCA, CySEC, and ASIC licences provide genuine oversight for a platform offering 8,000+ instruments, MetaTrader Supreme Edition (the best MT plugin available), and an education programme that genuinely teaches traders how to improve. The $25 minimum deposit and real stock investing make it accessible. But the 2025 financials tell a concerning story — EUR 16.2 million net loss, 51% revenue collapse, only 29,455 active clients. Fund segregation and regulatory protection mean your money is safe even in the worst case. But a broker fighting for survival may cut services, reduce support quality, or consolidate operations. Use Admirals for its education and tools — but monitor the financial situation and keep deposits modest.
